# UnO fixtures

Do not fabricate dumps. Every `.syx` here must come from:

- a physical FCB1010 with regular UnO, or
- a verified copy of such a capture under `hardware-captures/`

The test project links `hardware-captures/FCB1010-UnO-hardware-20260921-132357.syx` as `FCB1010-UnO-hardware.syx`.

See `FCB1010-UnO-hardware.metadata.json` for provenance.
